title: Kissed Kenyan Chicken Skillet
description: A mustardy, silky skillet dish that blends Kenyan flavors with dark soft brown sugar and nuka-pickle for a low-glycemic twist.
instructions: Heat the cast-iron skillet over medium heat and swirl in sesame oil until shimmering.
Pat the chicken thighs dry, season with pepper, then sear in the skillet for 4 minutes on each side until golden; remove and set aside.
Add garlic, ginger, and mustard to the hot oil, stirring until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Pour in soy sauce and dark soft brown sugar, allowing it to dissolve and form a caramelized glaze.
Return chicken to the skillet, spooning the glaze over the pieces and covering loosely.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Stir in nuka-pickle and scallions, cooking for an additional 2 minutes to meld flavors.
Serve hot, spooning extra glaze onto each piece for a silky finish.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
